_readme: The registry of CLAIMS this repository has WITHDRAWN, and the spellings that must not reappear. WFG-062. One entry per withdrawn claim: what was withdrawn, the artifact or escalation that withdrew it, the pragma tokens that license a deliberate mention, and the banned spellings. scripts/check_withdrawn_claims.py checks EVERY tracked .md and .html against every entry; tests/test_withdrawn_claims_registry.py is the gate. Adding a claim here gates it across the whole tree at once: that is the point of the file. See docs/withdrawn_claims.md for what it does and does NOT do.

scope._readme: The default is EVERY tracked .md and .html file. `record_prefixes` is the one exception class and every member carries a reason: these are the files whose job is to QUOTE a withdrawn claim in order to record that it was withdrawn. No judge reads them. A path may not be both a record path and a member of a hand-rolled guard list in tests/test_detection_ordering_is_not_claimed.py; the gate refuses that.

record_prefixes.why: every lap's report; their subject is often the claim that was withdrawn that lap
retired documents, kept under CHARTER §3 rule 7 (never delete) precisely as a record
the lessons file; a lesson about a withdrawn claim has to name it
escalations quote the claim they are asking the author about (NH-019 is one)
rows quote the withdrawn sentence as the row's own definition of done
the critic's series table quotes findings verbatim
the current critic findings, which name the claims they found
the readiness lines carry the finding history against each tick
the direction page quotes the critic's notes verbatim
the standing brief cites the claims as worked examples of its own rules
the verbatim routine prompts, a record by construction (CHARTER §9)
generated by scripts/auto/report.py from BACKLOG.md, which is itself a record path

claims.title: the registry stamp is unreachable from this branch
claims.claim: the 검증 레지스트리 card's 「built at commit 41498ef」 names a commit that is not reachable from HEAD, so the student must not say the screen's stamp is a commit this branch reaches
claims.withdrawn_by: critic #26 (2026-09-06T1100Z) measured it on a deepened clone and withdrew it; critic #27 (1400Z) re-measured on a FULLY unshallowed clone and filed WFG-133 because the withdrawal had reached three loop pages and not the card the student reads aloud. Re-verified by the 20260906T1520Z dev lap at 6cac7c6, `git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository` = false, 491 commits: `merge-base --is-ancestor 41498ef HEAD` exits 0, distance 286, `branch -a --contains` names auto/dev and origin/Main.
claims.artifact: docs/auto/JUDGE_QA.md Q35's ⚠⚠ block, which carries the measured table and the head it was taken at
claims.say_instead: 각인은 두 개이고 둘 다 이 브랜치에서 닿습니다. 레지스트리 카드의 각인은 더 오래된 것이고, 남은 결함은 그 줄이 낡았고 이름표가 틀렸다는 것입니다 (WFG-115)

spellings.why: the withdrawn assertion itself. Anchored on 브랜치에서 because 「닿지 않」 alone is ordinary Korean and the bank uses it correctly elsewhere for questions that have no answer yet

the instruction that made this dangerous rather than merely wrong: it told the student NOT to say the draft's true sentence. The prohibition (말하지 말-) is what is matched. An earlier draft of this entry matched 「커밋입니다」 문장을」 and claimed the object particle distinguished the prohibition from the card's true 「문장은 옳고」; that was false about Korean — 문장을 is the accusative marker and marks the sentence as the object of any verb, permission included — and the independent reviewer of dev lap 20260906T1520Z measured it firing on all three natural TRUE phrasings while missing the prohibition with one particle changed. The prohibition ending is [마말] because Korean negative imperatives take both 말고 and 마십시오/마세요; requiring 말 alone missed 「라는 문장은 말하지 마십시오」, which the reviewer's set caught

the plainest spelling of the withdrawn measurement, and the one live in docs/auto/JUDGE_QA.md's preserved record: 「`git merge-base --is-ancestor 41498ef HEAD` 는 0이 아닌 값으로 종료」. It exits 0. Found by the independent reviewer eight lines above the lines the lap had licensed
the same claim in the plainest Korean rewording (「41498ef 는 HEAD 의 조상이 아닙니다」). Written by the independent reviewer, who did not write these patterns
「각인은 이 브랜치에 없습니다」 — the reviewer's rewording, and the shape a lap would reach for after the two above are gated
the claim in English, for paper/manuscript.md and the research surfaces. WC-003 exists because the Korean guard lists did not read English
